title: An interest-payment waiver credits LOAN_PORTFOLIO, INTEREST_RECEIVABLE and OVERPAYMENT then debits the total to INTEREST_ON_LOANS (loan 7 L23: credits 1000.00 / 40.00 / 60.00, debit 1100.00)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry an INTEREST_PAYMENT_WAIVER posted on loan 7 (product LP1_INTEREST_FLAT, NOT charged off) on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits). request.interest_payment_waiver_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back transaction id 23 (externalId L23): principalPortion 1000.0 -> "100000", interestPortion 40.0 -> "4000", overpaymentPortion 60.0 -> "6000", fee 0, penalty 0. charged_off is the read-back's top-level chargedOff false. accounts is the product mapping from create-request-LP1_INTEREST_FLAT.json (sha256 af7c2cde...f13d). expect.interest_payment_waiver_journal_legs transcribes the four L23 legs in id order from the sweep: JE 56 CREDIT account 2 1000.0, JE 57 CREDIT account 4 40.0, JE 58 CREDIT account 17 60.0, JE 59 DEBIT account 9 1100.0. THIS VECTOR GRADES: the overpayment credit slot (account 17) in addition to the portfolio and receivable slots, and the single total debit. It does NOT grade the charged-off branch. Nothing was computed; exact decimals parsed to integer minor units, never a float.
